designs.title: Retained enclosure — current exterior
designs.role: 115 × 174 × 71 mm white enclosure candidate, with front buttons and underside USB-C. Buttons project to 72.2 mm. This compact version requires holder tails and solder joints trimmed to the documented limit; motor-family fit and printed tolerances remain provisional.

designs.title: Removable battery cassette and compact drive
designs.role: Two opposing three-cell carrier boards fit in a removable cassette. Separate controller supports, cable routes and adjustable front buttons are modeled. The controller is shown as a reserved volume; exact holder fastening and physical load tests remain open.

designs.title: Retained enclosure — service view
designs.role: The cover and cassette lid are separated to show access. Two integral cleats and one mounting screw retain the cassette; its modeled release and removal paths clear the controller and drive. These are prototype-fit files, pending tolerance and load qualification.

designs.title: Integrated controller — first component placement
designs.role: 54 × 68.5 mm black-board study, with USB-C, protected battery connection, motor tails and encoder/home ports. All 196 footprints are placed; no copper is routed. Thermal design, manufacturing rules and physical qualification remain open.

designs.title: Integrated controller — partial power routing
designs.role: Experimental four-layer route with 537 segments and 162 vias: local charger, motor, regulator, radio and USB power/control paths and charger capacitor banks. 64 physical connection groups and nineteen injected-fault checks pass; 275 unconnected items remain. USB data/factory access, remaining current/signal routes, thermal review and manufacturing checks are unfinished.

designs.title: Companion battery carrier — experimental copper
designs.role: Two-layer companion carrier with 35 copper segments, 12 vias and no disconnected nets. Four mounting-hole courtyard and six inherited silkscreen findings remain. Experimental only: current capacity, holder loading, insulation and pack assembly still require qualification.

designs.title: Primary battery carrier — partial current and sensing route
designs.role: Experimental 102-segment, 32-via current/Kelvin checkpoint. Ten current-path groups and two isolated sense branches are physically connected; 55 signal/bypass connections and 30 documented DRC findings remain. Thermal, holder, protection and assembly qualification are unfinished. Not a fabrication release.

designs.title: Reusable holder assembly fixture
designs.role: One reusable three-piece workshop fixture, shared across all eight builds. The modeled clearance and print meshes pass; actual rim contact, insertion forces and the complete pack-loading sequence remain unqualified. It adds no installed enclosure parts.

designs.title: Complete controller schematic
designs.role: Eleven native KiCad sheets cover all 196 circuit features and 609 pin identities. The exported net partition matches the PCB; seven documented ERC findings remain. Unrouted and unpowered.

designs.title: Adjustable front buttons — mechanism section
designs.role: Two captive M2 adjusters set the plungers to first electrical closure at the 0.4 mm positive stop. Jam nuts lock the setting. Switch return, printed friction, adjustment and repeated operation still require physical tests.

designs.title: Battery cassette — removable assembly
designs.role: Six holders on opposing carrier boards, a separate insulating barrier and a removable printed shell. The assembled cassette releases with a 2.5 mm lift and then moves forward; disconnect and handle the cables separately.

designs.title: Cassette retention — cutaway
designs.role: The cassette pocket captures the integral backplate cleat. Nominal interference confirms capture before the release slide; printed strength, creep and fit remain prototype tests.

designs.title: Holder carrier enclosure — provisional exterior
designs.role: Original 170 × 158 × 64 mm packaging study using six PCB-mounted holders and an independent chain shaft. Retention, electrical layout and purchased-part fit are still in development.

designs.title: Battery holders and supported drives, at the same scale
designs.role: Six packaging reservations. The two welded-pack options remain size references; the holder alternatives compare assembly effort, width and depth.

designs.title: Protected carrier and supported drive — exploded study
designs.role: Original 170 × 158 × 64 mm packaging study using six PCB-mounted holders and an independent chain shaft. Retention, electrical layout and purchased-part fit are still in development.

designs.title: One protected carrier — internal arrangement
designs.role: Original 170 × 158 × 64 mm packaging study using six PCB-mounted holders and an independent chain shaft. Retention, electrical layout and purchased-part fit are still in development.

designs.title: Motor driver — native KiCad circuit study
designs.role: Fourteen components and 43 physical pin connections agree with the atopile board graph. This open block has four documented ERC boundary findings; supply, controller, motor connector and regenerative-energy clamp are not yet integrated.

designs.title: Motor cutoff and reset — native KiCad circuit study
designs.role: Four ICs and ten passive parts. All 49 physical pin connections checked against the compiled circuit; two explicit external-power ERC findings. Physical cutoff and full-board qualification remain open.

designs.title: USB-C-fed 3S charger — native KiCad circuit study
designs.role: 36-part capture with 101 physical pins checked. A fourth PMID capacitor follows DC-bias review; effective capacitance remains a curve-based planning estimate. Ten explicit ERC findings and unfinished power/pack integration. Not a charging or fabrication release.

designs.title: Regenerative clamp and thermal latch — native KiCad circuit study
designs.role: 38 parts and 105 physical pins checked. Two explicit external-power ERC findings. Pulse energy, response time, thermal coupling and sustained back-drive remain unqualified.

designs.title: 3.3 V logic supply — native KiCad circuit study
designs.role: 12 parts and 31 physical pins checked. Internal 3.3 V divider; 1 A design envelope. Two external-power ERC findings. Biased capacitance, load transients, layout and hardware qualification remain open.

designs.title: Protected 3S2P carrier — native KiCad circuit study
designs.role: 33 parts and 103 physical pins checked, including three-cell sensing and six branch fuses. Fifteen explicit ERC boundary findings. Holder, thermistor, connector and secondary protection integration remain open; no battery fault safety or fabrication approval is implied.

designs.title: USB-C PD input — native KiCad circuit study
designs.role: 33 parts and 113 physical pins checked. Three explicit external-power ERC findings. Mandatory factory PD profile, surge behavior, startup and integrated charging remain unqualified; not a fabrication release.

designs.title: Compact enclosure — provisional exterior
designs.role: Earlier study, before PCB-mounted holders and independent shaft support. Initial compact direct-drive packaging candidate. Original parametric geometry; purchased-part fit and the holder-carrier alternative remain under review.

designs.title: Four layouts at the same scale
designs.role: Earlier study, before PCB-mounted holders and independent shaft support. Calculated front footprints from the original packaging study. Dimensions and purchased-part envelopes remain provisional.

designs.title: Compact enclosure — exploded study
designs.role: Earlier study, before PCB-mounted holders and independent shaft support. Enclosure and internal fit study. Motor, cells and PCB are reserved envelopes; attachment and drive details are still being developed.

designs.title: Compact direct drive — packaging study
designs.role: Earlier study, before PCB-mounted holders and independent shaft support. Compact direct drive with three cell columns and two depth layers. Provisional packaging study.

designs.title: Wide and shallow — packaging study
designs.role: Earlier study, before PCB-mounted holders and independent shaft support. Six cells across one depth layer. Provisional packaging study.

designs.title: Narrow with right-angle drive — packaging study
designs.role: Earlier study, before PCB-mounted holders and independent shaft support. Narrow footprint with a right-angle transmission envelope. Gears are not yet functional designs.

designs.title: Tall and shallow direct drive — packaging study
designs.role: Earlier study, before PCB-mounted holders and independent shaft support. Two vertical rows of three cells in a single depth layer. Provisional packaging study.

designs.title: PD12V6Mini — inherited power-board reference
designs.role: Existing e8s USB-C PD to 12.6 V power supply. This is not the new controller or a battery charger; no new hardware validation is implied.
